_doc: Autosave (docs/18, src/save/autosave.js). debounceS: wait after an edit before saving; minIntervalS: routine saves at most this often (hiding or closing the tab always saves at once); generationsKept: saved copies kept per island, newest first.
_catchUp: Time away (docs/02, docs/future/01, src/sim/away.js). awayRate: game hours earned per real minute away (watched time at 1x is 1), also for a hidden tab; capHours: the most game hours one return brings (168 is 7 game days); blockHours: game hours per worker job (progress steps); screenAfterS: the catching-up screen shows only if catch-up takes longer than this; pretendHours: the badge's Pretend I was away choices, in game hours earned.

catchUp._restTitle: The first rest only: the ebb wordmark rises over riseS seconds and the cream stays at least holdS before fading with the dawn (Phase 1 fix F14).
catchUp._restNotes: A night's rest keeps at most this many notes, one per kind of change (Phase 1 fix F3).

_recovered: The calm note when an island came back from a damaged save (S7d, src/save/recover.js), shown in the island's notes corner for showS seconds: earlier when the newest copy was damaged and the one before opened; parts when only some parts came from earlier copies; landRegrew and journalFresh are added when no copy had a damaged chunk or the journal.

recovered.earlier: Your island came back from a few minutes earlier.
recovered.parts: Your island is here. A small part of it came back from a few minutes earlier.
recovered.landRegrew: A small piece of the land grew back as it first was.
recovered.journalFresh: The journal starts a fresh page.
recovered.setAside: Planting happens on foot now, so a new island begins here. Your earlier island is kept aside.

_reveal: The reveal on return (docs/02, src/ui/reveal.js). thresholdHours: from this much time away the full reveal plays, below it a short growth time-lapse; creamFadeS: the cream opening; growS / shortGrowS: the time-lapse; growSpread: share of growS by which plants start apart (the ripple); calmSpread: the same with calm motion (Settings), when the long reveal uses shortGrowS too; notesAtS, noteS, notes: when notes start, each one's time, how many; places: rings on the island, ringM their radius (m); animalsAtS: when the animals come back, all within animalsWindowS with at most animalEffects plops or ripples island-wide, the nearest the camera.
